Title: Mixed-colour card-protectors for your crypt - legal?

Messages.Author: legbiter
Messages.Body:
Michael has built a Malkavian antitribu combat deck which he calls his
Chess deck - chess because he can. In keeping with the theme, he has
sleeved all the crypt cards in red sleeves, while exactly half the
library cards are in black sleeves, and half are in white sleeves. i
was wondering idly whether this would be legal in tournament play,
given that mixed-back Jyhad/VTES libraries ARE ok provided no marking
is going on. Does anyone know for sure? Thanks in advance for any
help!

Messages.Author: Sten During
Messages.Body:



Sten During

Messages.Author: James Dyes
Messages.Body:
"legbiter" <legb...@mailandnews.com> wrote in message
news:22fea992.02042...@posting.google.com...



As long as he isn't actually using the different color ones to denote a
specific set of cards (like, for instance, making all the stealth mods
in red...so he knows that if he is drawing a red card, it has a good
chance of being a stealth card). Generally speaking, while not illegal,
it should be frowned upon...it just *looks* illegal:-) Of course, there
is no problem if your crypt is all one color, and your library is
another color. I do that all the time.

jim
